sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 860. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Boosts HP recovery effects by 100% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Heals 40% of max HP every 5 seconds for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Grace for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
-Target: all allies. Increases Fire, Water, Wind, Light, Dark, Time, and Star elemental attack by 20 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases fire, water, wind, light, dark, time, and star elemental attack buff limit by 10 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases max Unison gauge capacity by 20 for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Infinite Element (increases all stats by 120%, restores 5% of damage dealt as HP, and increases HP recovery effects by 50%) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 50000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 50000
Fire and Wind Defense from Unison Damage +700
